provenance.definition: Origin of the information signal: whether it originates from empirical ground-truth measurements, evaluator scoring, or teacher trajectories (Oracle), or from a priori formal grammatical definitions of the task language (Non-Oracle).

example_specificity.definition: Instance-dependence of the signal: whether the signal varies point-wise with each input sequence x or contains sequence-specific coordinate constants (Oracle), or is an x-invariant universal rule (Non-Oracle).

relation_specificity.definition: Scope and tailoring of the signal: whether the signal is an ad-hoc coordinate patch tailored to a specific dataset/relation (Oracle), or a domain-general compositional operator across relations (Non-Oracle).

inference_time_availability.definition: Legitimacy of signal exposure during open-world testing: whether the signal relies on evaluator privilege/secret target tokens (Oracle), or is legitimately part of the visible task query/prompt at inference time (Non-Oracle).

counterfactual_invariance.definition: Robustness under input sequence perturbations: whether the signal breaks when sequence layout, distractor positions, or lengths change (Oracle), or dynamically preserves semantic meaning across counterfactual variations (Non-Oracle).

controls_evaluated.name: pre_declared_semantic_rule
controls_evaluated.description: Task/relation-wide pre-declared semantic operational rule in formal grammar (e.g. key matching predicate and offset).
controls_evaluated.syntax_and_representation: RULE(match_predicate=lambda k, x_i: x_i == k, target_offset=+1)
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Abstract relational operational predicate without sequence index literals.

controls_evaluated.name: opaque_task_id
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Nominal index identifying task category; zero semantic or coordinate bits.

controls_evaluated.name: per_example_coordinate_label
controls_evaluated.description: Explicit ground-truth target routing coordinate z*(x) supplied per sequence.
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Direct supervisory target coordinate for router cross-entropy loss.

controls_evaluated.name: relation_specific_lookup_map
controls_evaluated.description: Hard-coded coordinate lookup map k -> z* or (x, k) -> z* tailored to relation.
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Exhaustive table mapping input keys to internal sequence coordinates.

controls_evaluated.name: universal_interpreter_plus_relation_code
controls_evaluated.description: Coordinate lookup table compiled into a universal bytecode interpreter and compact relation code (meaning-preserving re-encoding).
controls_evaluated.syntax_and_representation: EXEC(I_univ, c_t) where c_t = [OP_LOAD, k, OP_RET, z*]
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Isomorphic to PC2 (H(T_coord | I_univ, c_t) = 0); unpacks exact coordinate lookup table.

controls_evaluated.name: compressed_or_encrypted_lookup
controls_evaluated.description: Coordinate lookup table compressed via DEFLATE or encrypted via AES/PRNG with key K_t (meaning-preserving re-encoding).
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Isomorphic to PC2 (reconstructed coordinate map is bitwise identical to ground-truth table).

controls_evaluated.name: relation_specific_coordinate_free_metadata
controls_evaluated.description: Relation-specific semantic metadata (e.g. arity=2, commutativity=False, value_type=INT) strictly free of coordinate maps or index offsets.
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Algebraic and type signature metadata; zero coordinate or index information.

controls_evaluated.name: example_independent_task_specific_routing_program
controls_evaluated.description: Static programmatic routing rule engineered for relation t that is example-independent (content-blind), e.g. z*(k) = (2*k + 1) % L.
controls_evaluated.syntax_and_representation: def route_t(k, L): return (2 * k + 1) % L
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Hard-coded positional coordinate schedule engineered to match data generation layout of relation t.

controls_evaluated.name: support_derived_selector
controls_evaluated.description: Candidate routing selector dynamically induced from few-shot input-output support examples S = {(x_m, y_m)} without coordinate supervision.
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Empirically fitted selector rule from token examples; lacks coordinate ground truth.
controls_evaluated.classification: LAWFUL_TASK_SPEC (Under-determined on collision under token-only supervision)

controls_evaluated.name: lawful_first_last_descriptor
controls_evaluated.description: Compositional semantic descriptor equipped with universal tie-break policy in {FIRST, LAST}.
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: Formal declarative specification of intensional task objective; requires runtime sequence search over x to resolve coordinates.

controls_evaluated.name: noisy_coordinate_hint
controls_evaluated.description: Ground-truth coordinate z*(x) corrupted with 20% random offset noise or coarse positional interval binning.
controls_evaluated.information_theoretic_content: High-mutual-information coordinate hint derived from evaluator target trajectory.

representation_invariance.hypothesis: Does re-encoding ground-truth coordinate lookups into meaning-preserving functional or cryptographic representations evade detection?

evaluations.detection_mechanism: Provenance confirms compiler ingested evaluator ground truth; Counterfactual Invariance exposes hard-coded offsets failing under sequence mutation.
Information-theoretic content is isomorphic; decrypted payload contains explicit coordinate constants; cannot be constructed for unseen relations without evaluator privilege.
A priori formal grammar and domain generality hold identically across syntactic variations.

representation_invariance.conclusion: The 5-dimensional oracle criterion is invariant under meaning-preserving re-encodings. No syntactic transformation can disguise an oracle as a lawful non-oracle.

positive_negative_monotonicity.hypothesis: Does the oracle score S(C) monotonically track the degree of ground-truth coordinate leakage lambda(C) in signal C?
positive_negative_monotonicity.monotonicity_ordering: S(NC1, NC2, MC3, MC5, MC6) [0] < S(MC4) [4] <= S(PC1, PC2, MC1, MC2, MC7) [5]

leave_one_out_analysis.hypothesis: Is every dimension in the 5-dimensional criterion strictly necessary, or does omitting any single dimension create an exploitable loophole?

dimension_removals.exploit_scenario: Evaluator-synthesized coordinate schedule mathematically disguised as a pure functional closed-form formula.
dimension_removals.adversarial_vulnerability: Synthetic evaluator cheat sheets generated from ground truth bypass detection if only surface form is inspected.

dimension_removals.exploit_scenario: Per-instance coordinate label (PC1) disguised as a dynamic relation with single-instance bindings.
dimension_removals.adversarial_vulnerability: Cannot distinguish point-wise instance-level coordinate leakage from relation-level parameters.

dimension_removals.exploit_scenario: Example-independent task-specific routing program (MC4) that hard-codes dataset layout offsets.
dimension_removals.adversarial_vulnerability: Relation-tailored ad-hoc coordinate patches would be treated as universal operators, admitting MC4.

dimension_removals.exploit_scenario: Target trajectory or teacher coordinate map supplied exclusively during training as 'auxiliary context'.
dimension_removals.adversarial_vulnerability: Evaluator privilege during training admitted as lawful context, violating open-world holdout evaluation.

dimension_removals.exploit_scenario: Layout-brittle positional heuristics (e.g. key_0 -> index 1) that fail under sequence mutation.
dimension_removals.adversarial_vulnerability: Static positional lookup tables evade detection by pretending to be structural task invariants.

aggregation_threshold_analysis.hypothesis: What aggregation threshold theta over the 5-dimensional score S(C) minimizes False Positives (rejecting lawful descriptors) and False Negatives (admitting oracles)?

thresholds_evaluated.condition: IsOracle(C) iff S(C) >= 1 (any single oracle dimension triggers rejection)

recommended_policy.justification: Because all lawful semantic task specifications (NC1, NC2, MC3, MC5, MC6) score strictly 0/5, setting threshold theta = 1 introduces zero False Positives while providing maximum fail-closed security against partial, disguised, or mixed oracles.

searched_spaces: Meaning-preserving re-encodings of coordinate lookups (bytecode VM, compression, encryption)
Support-derived dynamic selectors under token-only supervision
Lawful tie-break descriptors under alternative semantic formulations
counterexample_search.detail: Zero instances where re-encoding changes the determination of oracle content, and zero instances where lawful FIRST/LAST descriptors exhibit oracle characteristics.

core_invariants.content_path_isolation: h_content = f(content): input sequence x is encoded by content encoder with zero task-conditioning, zero tie-break hints, and zero task ID leakage.
core_invariants.task_conditioning_path: Router receives compositional descriptor D = (OpFamily, Arguments, TieBreakPolicy) via a separate task-conditioning branch.
core_invariants.tie_break_specification: TieBreakPolicy in {FIRST, LAST, LEFTMOST, RIGHTMOST, CENTER, ARBITRARY}; domain-general algebraic extremum policy independent of input token values.
core_invariants.loss_supervision: Standard task cross-entropy loss over output tokens y; zero auxiliary coordinate loss, zero teacher routing trajectories, zero duplicate-aware gradient masking.
core_invariants.oracle_criterion_compliance: Signal must score strictly 0/5 under the pre-registered 5-dimensional oracle criterion (theta = 1 fail-closed).

training_information_contract_v1_1.collision_resolution_mechanism: On duplicate-token collision sequences where token loss gradients are symmetric (e.g. x=[K, V, K, V]), distinct descriptors (D_A with FIRST vs D_B with LAST) provide distinct conditioning vectors to the router, enabling it to learn the specified directional attention policy from token output supervision alone.

descriptor_only_deterministic_baseline_r.name: Descriptor-Only Deterministic Execution Baseline
descriptor_only_deterministic_baseline_r.purpose: Establish the causal deterministic performance ceiling before evaluating any learned neural router, ensuring that task specification is decoupled from neural optimization capacity.

specifications.reduction_algorithm: Executes deterministic reduction R(x, D, query_step) in O(L) time via explicit symbolic evaluation of OpFamily, Arguments, and TieBreakPolicy.
specifications.causal_control_role: Serves as the deterministic ceiling control. Any failure of a learned neural model under Contract v1.1 is strictly attributable to neural architecture, optimization, or capacity limitations, rather than contractual under-determination.
